<style id="daily-study-style">/* Daily entry stays scoped; the original exercises and record fields are shared. */

.ds-home{--ds-ink:#263e35;--ds-green:#285745;--ds-muted:#65756c;--ds-line:#dbe3d7;--ds-wash:#f0f3e9;color:var(--ds-ink);margin:0 0 40px;font-family:inherit}

.ds-home *,.ds-dock *,.ds-dialog *{box-sizing:border-box}.ds-home [hidden],.ds-dock[hidden],.ds-dialog [hidden]{display:none!important}

.ds-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px;margin:6px 0 30px}.ds-eyebrow{font:600 10px/1.5 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:#718174;margin:0 0 10px}.ds-heading h1{font-size:clamp(26px,3.3vw,39px);letter-spacing:-.6px;line-height:1.35;margin:0 0 12px}.ds-heading>div>p:last-child{font-size:14px;color:var(--ds-muted);margin:0}.ds-date{font-size:12px;color:var(--ds-muted);white-space:nowrap;padding-top:6px}

.ds-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(290px,.85fr);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 35px #314c3b05}.ds-setup{padding:30px}.ds-section-label{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 14px}.ds-section-label>span{font:500 11px/1.6 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:#81937e}.ds-section-label h2{font-size:15px;margin:0;line-height:1.6}.ds-section-label small{font-size:11px;color:#6e7c70;margin-left:auto;text-align:right}

.ds-duration{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:0 0 30px}.ds-duration button{background:#fafbf7;border:1px solid #dde4d9;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 8px;color:#536351;font-size:12px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;min-height:82px}.ds-duration strong{font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:27px;line-height:1.4;margin-right:2px}.ds-duration span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#70816f;margin-top:1px}.ds-duration button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#ecf2e6;border:2px solid #476b4f;padding:12px 7px;color:#294e37}.ds-duration button:hover{background:#f0f4e9}

.ds-skills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px}.ds-skills button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:41px;border:1px solid #dce2d7;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#4a5a4c;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer}.ds-skills button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#eff4e9;border-color:#78976e;color:#274a32}.ds-skills button[aria-pressed=true]:before{content:'✓';font-size:12px}.ds-skills button:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default}.ds-skills button[data-ds-skill=auto]{flex-basis:100%;justify-content:flex-start;background:#f8faf5}.ds-selection-note{min-height:38px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ds-muted);margin:14px 0 22px}

.ds-start-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-home .ds-primary,.ds-dock .ds-primary,.ds-dialog .ds-primary{background:#285745;color:white;border:1px solid #285745;border-radius:9px;padding:13px 22px;min-height:48px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px}.ds-home .ds-primary:hover,.ds-dock .ds-primary:hover{background:#1c4636}.ds-start-row>span{font-size:12px;color:#63735f}.ds-footnote{font-size:11px;color:#77816f;margin:12px 0 0}

.ds-preview{background:#f3f5ed;border-left:1px solid var(--ds-line);padding:28px 26px}.ds-preview-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.ds-preview-heading h2{font-size:19px;margin:0}.ds-preview-heading .ds-eyebrow{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:6px}.ds-total{white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;color:#5f7255;background:#e6ecdf;border-radius:20px;padding:6px 10px}.ds-plan-reason{font-size:12px;line-height:1.75;color:#637359;margin:16px 0 19px}.ds-steps{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}.ds-steps li{position:relative;padding:0 0 18px 27px;margin:0;border-left:1px solid #d0dcc9;margin-left:8px}.ds-steps li:last-child{border-left-color:transparent;padding-bottom:0}.ds-step-dot{position:absolute;left:-9px;top:1px;width:17px;height:17px;background:#f3f5ed;border:1px solid #bccbb3;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:10px;color:#486045}.ds-steps li.is-current .ds-step-dot{background:#2f5b41;border-color:#2f5b41;color:#fff}.ds-steps li.is-done .ds-step-dot{background:#e1eacf;color:#38572e}.ds-step-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:baseline}.ds-step-line strong{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6}.ds-step-line small{font-size:11px;color:#6e7b62;white-space:nowrap}.ds-steps li>p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.75;color:#6c7a64;margin:4px 0 0}.ds-plan-foot{font-size:10px;line-height:1.7;color:#7e8974;border-top:1px solid #dce3d3;padding-top:15px;margin:21px 0 0}.ds-more{padding:5px 0;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;background:transparent;border:0;color:#496247;cursor:pointer}

.ds-message{font-size:13px;background:#f4eedc;color:#695434;border:1px solid #e2d7b4;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;margin:16px 0}.ds-completed{padding:20px 24px;background:#edf3e6;border:1px solid #d5e1cb;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:20px}.ds-completed h2{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-completed p{font-size:13px;color:#5b6e52;margin:6px 0}.ds-feedback{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}.ds-feedback button{background:#fff;border:1px solid #becdb4;border-radius:7px;min-height:40px;padding:7px 12px;color:#3b5636;font-size:12px}.ds-feedback button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#dce9ce;border-color:#6b885e}

.ds-dock{position:fixed;z-index:35;bottom:18px;left:calc(50% + 110px);transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(980px,calc(100vw - 272px));border:1px solid #ccd9c4;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 40px #213d2b22;padding:16px 20px;background:#fffffc;display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:center;color:#2d4937}.ds-dock-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-dock-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#6b7f62;margin:0 0 4px}.ds-dock-title{font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 5px;font-weight:600}.ds-dock-instruction{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#5c7054;margin:0;max-width:670px}.ds-dock-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}.ds-dock button:not(.ds-primary),.ds-dock a{font-size:12px;color:#3f6246;border:1px solid #d6e0d0;background:#f7f9f3;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 11px;min-height:40px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}.ds-dock .ds-primary{font-size:12px;min-height:40px;padding:10px 14px;gap:8px}.ds-dock-time{font:500 12px/1.5 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:#5c7254;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}.ds-dock-active main{padding-bottom:210px!important}.ds-dock-active .toast,.ds-dock-active .la-notice{bottom:170px}

.ds-dialog{width:min(540px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:85vh;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #d1dccb;border-radius:16px;padding:26px;color:#2c4434;background:#fffffc}.ds-dialog::backdrop{background:#172e2566}.ds-dialog h2{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 12px}.ds-dialog p,.ds-dialog label{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}.ds-dialog textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:140px;border:1px solid #bdcbb4;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin:12px 0 16px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;resize:vertical}.ds-dialog-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between}.ds-dialog-actions button{min-height:42px;padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid #cdd9c4;border-radius:8px;background:#f2f5eb;color:#355534;cursor:pointer}.ds-home button:focus-visible,.ds-dock button:focus-visible,.ds-dock a:focus-visible,.ds-dialog button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #95b780;outline-offset:3px}

body.ds-enabled #guide>.ww-entry,body.ds-enabled #guide>.cw-entry,body.ds-enabled #guide>.res-callout,body.ds-enabled #guide>.page-heading,body.ds-enabled #guide>.home-top,body.ds-enabled #guide>.path-strip,body.ds-enabled #guide>.la-heading,body.ds-enabled #guide>#la-resume{display:none!important}

@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(270px,.9fr)}.ds-setup{padding:24px}.ds-preview{padding:24px 20px}.ds-dock{left:calc(50% + 85px);width:calc(100vw - 208px);gap:12px}.ds-dock-actions{max-width:255px}.ds-section-label small{font-size:10px}}

@media(max-width:850px){.ds-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-preview{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--ds-line)}.ds-dock{width:calc(100vw - 32px);left:50%;bottom:12px}.ds-dock-active main{padding-bottom:240px!important}.ds-date{display:none}.ds-dock-actions{max-width:240px}}

@media(max-width:520px){.ds-heading{margin-bottom:22px}.ds-heading h1{font-size:26px}.ds-heading>div>p:last-child{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}.ds-setup{padding:22px 18px}.ds-section-label{gap:8px}.ds-section-label small{max-width:110px;font-size:10px}.ds-duration{gap:7px;margin-bottom:25px}.ds-duration strong{font-size:25px}.ds-skills{gap:8px}.ds-skills button{padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px;min-height:42px}.ds-selection-note{min-height:0;margin-bottom:18px}.ds-start-row .ds-primary{width:100%;justify-content:center}.ds-start-row>span{display:none}.ds-preview{padding:22px 19px}.ds-dock{padding:12px 14px;gap:10px;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;bottom:8px;width:calc(100vw - 20px)}.ds-dock-title{font-size:13px}.ds-dock-instruction{font-size:11px;max-height:54px;overflow:auto}.ds-dock-actions{max-width:none;gap:7px;justify-content:flex-start}.ds-dock-actions .ds-primary{margin-left:auto}.ds-dock button:not(.ds-primary),.ds-dock a{font-size:11px;padding:8px 9px}.ds-dock-time{font-size:10px}.ds-dock-active main{padding-bottom:280px!important}}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-home *,.ds-dock *{scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

.ds-writing-types{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-basis:100%;padding-top:4px}.ds-writing-types button{font-size:11px!important;min-height:38px!important;border-style:dashed!important}

.ds-home button:disabled{cursor:default}.ds-home .ds-primary:disabled,.ds-dock .ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5}.ds-duration button:disabled{opacity:.7}

@media print{.ds-home,.ds-dock,.ds-dialog{display:none!important}.ds-dock-active main{padding-bottom:0!important}}

</style><!--/DAILY-STUDY-V1:style--><style id="navigation-ui-final-style">/* Four entry points; subject pickers precede the activity catalog. */

#workspace-navigation nav{display:grid;gap:9px;padding-top:18px}

#workspace-navigation nav button{min-height:54px;font-size:17px;border-radius:11px;padding:14px 18px;justify-content:flex-start}

#workspace-navigation nav button[aria-current="page"]{background:#244d3b;color:#fff}

#workspace-navigation .sidebar-goal{margin-top:28px;padding:18px;font-size:13px}

.la-heading{margin-bottom:22px;padding-bottom:22px}

.la-heading .la-kicker{display:none}

.la-heading h1{letter-spacing:-.035em}

.la-subject-card{position:relative;padding:24px;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;min-height:218px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

.la-subject-card:hover{background:#f7faf5;border-color:#829a85}

.la-subject-card h2{font-size:29px;line-height:1.2;margin:12px 0}

.la-subject-card>.la-kicker{color:#70836e;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em}

.la-subject-card>a{margin-top:auto;padding-top:12px;text-decoration:none}

.la-subject-card>a:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:14px}

.la-subject-card:focus-within{outline:3px solid #95b197;outline-offset:3px}

#la-study-cards,#la-practice-cards{align-items:stretch}

.la-card-actions a{font-size:14px;text-decoration:none}

.la-card-actions button{margin-left:auto;border-color:transparent;background:#f1f5ee}

.la-card[data-catalog-unit]{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}

.la-card[data-catalog-unit] .la-card-actions{margin-top:auto;padding-top:10px}

.la-card[data-catalog-unit] h3{font-size:19px}

.la-card[data-catalog-unit]>.la-kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0}

.la-quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin:0 0 32px}

.la-quick-main{background:#244d3b;color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:24px}

.la-quick-main h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:22px;color:inherit}

.la-quick-main p{font-size:14px;color:#e0eadb;margin:6px 0 18px}

.la-quick-main a{display:inline-block;color:#fff;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid #a9c1aa;padding-bottom:4px}

.la-quick-side{border:1px solid #dce4dc;border-radius:14px;padding:20px 24px;background:#fff}

.la-quick-side h2{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 14px;color:#66755f}

#la-resume{border:0;padding:0;min-height:38px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}

.la-quick-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:15px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #e3e9df;margin-top:12px;font-size:13px}

.la-study-extras{margin-top:30px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid #dce4dc}

.la-study-extras>h2{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 16px}

.la-extra-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}

.la-extra-grid>a{display:grid;gap:7px;padding:18px 20px;background:#f0f4eb;border:1px solid #dce4d5;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none}

.la-extra-grid strong{font-size:18px}.la-extra-grid span{font-size:13px;color:#64715f}

.la-toolbar{gap:14px;background:#f0f3ec;align-items:end}

.la-toolbar label{flex:1;min-width:130px}.la-toolbar label:has(input){flex:1.6}

.la-toolbar input{min-width:0;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}

.la-toolbar select{width:100%}

.la-toolbar label[hidden],.la-quick[hidden],.la-study-extras[hidden],[data-la-focus-hidden]{display:none!important}

.la-focus-nav{padding:0 0 18px;gap:8px 18px;font-size:14px}.la-focus-nav a{white-space:nowrap}.la-focus-nav span{flex-basis:100%;font-size:20px;color:#253e2e;font-weight:600}

.la-section-links{align-items:center;min-height:0}.la-section-links:empty{display:none}

.la-section-links a{border:0;padding:4px 0;font-size:14px}.la-section-links a+a:before{content:"/";padding-right:12px;color:#909c8b}

.la-section-links>span{color:#76806f;font-size:14px}

.la-workspace-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}

.la-workspace-grid .la-card{margin:0}.la-workspace-grid h2{font-size:21px}

.la-test-selection{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important}.la-test-selection .la-card p{font-size:13px}

.la-mock-card{margin-top:28px;background:#eff4e9;padding:24px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #d0dec6}

.la-mock-card h2{font-size:23px;margin:0 0 10px}

#current-page-label{max-width:min(70vw,720px);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}

#guide>.la-hidden-legacy{display:none!important}

@media(min-width:1100px){#study>.la-grid:has(.la-subject-card),#practice>.la-grid:has(.la-subject-card){grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}#study>.la-grid:has([data-subject="writing1"]),#practice>.la-grid:has([data-subject="writing1"]){grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}

@media(max-width:1000px){.la-test-selection{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}.la-quick{grid-template-columns:1fr}.la-extra-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.la-subject-card{min-height:190px}}

@media(max-width:600px){.la-extra-grid,.la-workspace-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.la-test-selection{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}.la-subject-card{padding:18px;min-height:190px}.la-subject-card h2{font-size:24px}.la-card[data-catalog-unit]{padding:18px}.la-quick-main,.la-quick-side{padding:20px}.la-progress{gap:8px;font-size:12px}.la-progress progress{width:72px}.la-toolbar label{min-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}.la-test-controls{position:static}#current-page-label{max-width:64vw}.la-heading h1{font-size:30px}}

</style><style id="health-study-ui-style">

/* Keep the existing warm paper/green design, with one unobstructed action area. */

body.nav-open #daily-study-dock,body.nav-open #energy-reminder{display:none!important}

body.hs-dock-visible #energy-reminder{display:none!important}

body.ds-dock-active main{padding-bottom:var(--hs-dock-space,240px)!important}

.ds-dialog{overscroll-behavior:contain}

.hs-rest-status{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin:8px 0 0;color:#35533f}

.hs-rest-clock{font:500 13px/1.5 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#526849}

.hs-rest-clock:empty{display:none}

body.health-resting .ds-dock .ds-dock-time{display:none}

#hs-details{display:none}

#hs-rest,#hs-finish{min-height:44px}

.ds-dock button,.ds-dock a{touch-action:manipulation}

.ds-dock{bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}

@media(max-width:520px){

  .ds-dock{padding:12px 13px;gap:6px;bottom:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));width:calc(100vw - 20px)}

  .ds-dock:not(.hs-expanded) .ds-dock-instruction,.ds-dock:not(.hs-expanded) [data-hs-secondary]{display:none!important}

  #hs-details{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

  .ds-dock .ds-dock-actions{gap:6px}

  .ds-dock .ds-dock-actions button,.ds-dock .ds-dock-actions a{min-height:44px;font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px}

  .ds-dock .ds-dock-actions .ds-primary{margin-left:auto}

  .ds-dock .ds-dock-time{font-size:11px;flex-basis:100%;line-height:1.3}

  .ds-dock-label{font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px}

  .ds-dock-title{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:2px}

  .ds-dock-instruction{max-height:min(22vh,150px);font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;overscroll-behavior:contain}

  .hs-rest-status{font-size:12px;margin-top:4px}

  .hs-rest-clock{font-size:12px}

  .workspace-topbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px minmax(0,1fr) auto;grid-template-rows:auto auto;height:auto;min-height:61px;padding:8px 14px 6px;gap:2px 10px}

  .workspace-topbar .mobile-menu{grid-column:1;grid-row:1}

  .workspace-topbar .breadcrumb{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;min-width:0}

  .workspace-topbar #current-page-label{max-width:100%}

  .workspace-topbar .topbar-actions,.workspace-topbar .save-indicator{display:contents}

  .workspace-topbar .save-indicator>i{display:none}

  .workspace-topbar #lookup-open{grid-column:3;grid-row:1}

  .workspace-topbar #save-status{grid-column:2 / 4;grid-row:2;font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

}



</style>
<!--JIJING-20260920:css--><style>.jj-unit{max-width:1000px;margin:24px auto;padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff}.jj-unit audio{width:100%;margin:16px 0}.jj-context{padding:18px 22px;background:#f5f6ee;border-left:3px solid #9eaf9a;line-height:1.85}.jj-context p{margin:0 0 15px}.jj-question{margin:24px 0;padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.jj-unit .pp-key{margin:26px 0;padding:18px}.jj-transcript{font-size:15px;line-height:1.8}.jj-unit h3{margin-top:26px}.jj-unit textarea{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}.jj-unit .la-gate-content[hidden]{display:none!important}@media(max-width:640px){.jj-unit{padding:14px}.jj-context{padding:14px}}</style><!--/JIJING-20260920--><style id="workspace-split-style">

#workspace .la-card>a{margin-top:auto;padding-top:16px}

#workspace-navigation .ws-nav-divider{display:block;margin:16px 18px 0;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #d1dccf;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#667c68}

#development .ws-development-item p{color:#586b5d;line-height:1.8}

#development .ws-development-item a{margin-top:auto;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;font-weight:600}

@media(min-width:1380px){#workspace .la-workspace-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}

@media(max-width:1000px){body.ws-wide main{padding-left:22px;padding-right:22px}}
